title: Hong Kong requires every licensed crypto exchange to custody client assets through a wholly-owned su
content:
Hong Kong requires every licensed crypto exchange to custody client assets through a wholly-owned subsidiary. Third-party custodians are not accepted.
>>> This is unique. In Singapore, exchanges can use external custodians. In the UAE, custody can be a separately licensed entity. In Hong Kong, you must build and own your custodian

The SFC has licensed 12 VATPs as of February 2026: HashKey, OSL, Bullish, BGE, VDX, and others. Each one had to establish a captive custody subsidiary
